title: DONKII: Characterizing and Detecting Errors in Instruction-Tuning Datasets
reasoning: The paper includes an 'Ethics & Broader Impact' section which discusses the ethical imperative of fine-grained control over model outputs and the content of instruction-tuning datasets. It delves into how annotator demographics and disagreements about what constitutes an error impact data quality, and the need for broader discussions on the 'desired behaviour of LLMs' and what constitutes an 'error' in such datasets. This goes beyond a simple disclaimer and touches on the moral and ethical dimensions of data annotation and LLM behavior.
